scope: Run & Bun strategy integration: every Battle_AI.rb lead that names a Rejuvenation field. The strategy (rejuvenation-engine.js strategy()) executes candidate moves/switches in the installed simulator with the field engine and values the outcome; it never re-implements a field formula.

decisions.semantics: pbRoughDamage / pbBetterBaseDamage estimate field-modified damage (type, ability, item and move multipliers, fixed and weight-based powers, Concert rolls, Chess/Big Top/Short-Circuit rolls, ruin and aura modifiers). The strategy never estimates damage: bestAttack and every rollout run measure()/runMove through the simulator with the field engine attached, including the fixed Concert 1/4 damage rolls and expected critical stages. Field damage mechanics themselves are certified by the runtime source reviews.
tests: strategy decisions consume the measured field mechanic in every AI prediction category
fixed field damage rolls (Concert 1 and 4) govern previews and lookahead damage
preview total ranges agree with complete simulator hit outcomes including protection and multiple hits
guaranteed critical policies and Gigantamax moves survive the shared range pipeline
critical-hit stages raise the measured damage potential

decisions.semantics: pbTypeModNoMessages, canGroundMoveHit?, bothOpponentsImmune?, isValidDragonDartsTarget, moveSuccessful? and moveInvulMisses? predict field-dependent immunity, absorption, failure, grounding and target validity. measure() reports the simulator's own TryMove/TryHit/immunity/accuracy result and the rollout executes the move, so a field-caused failure, absorption or immunity (Inverse charts, Psychic Terrain priority blocking, Damp on Misty/Swamp, Rocky bullet blocking, Desert sun absorption) is what the strategy sees.
tests: strategy decisions consume the measured field mechanic in every AI prediction category
Inverse field reverses type immunities and preserves Levitate
field priority additions cover hard terrain, overlays, chess roles and negative moves

decisions.semantics: notOHKO? / survivesAt1HP? predict Sturdy-like survival (Colosseum Stalwart, Chess pawns, Frozen Dimension Ice Face). The rollout applies the simulator Damage event, so the target survives at 1 HP exactly when the field says so and the KO bonus is not awarded.
tests: strategy decisions consume the measured field mechanic in every AI prediction category

decisions.semantics: pbRoughAccuracy / accuracyWeatherAbilityActive? estimate field accuracy changes. measure() computes accuracy as hitStepAccuracy does (ModifyAccuracy, boosts, Accuracy event) with the field attached; every candidate below 100% is evaluated as a connect branch and a miss branch weighted by that measured accuracy, and damage potential is accuracy-weighted.
tests: strategy decisions consume the measured field mechanic in every AI prediction category
accuracy replacement
source accuracy changes honor airborne targets and ability suppression

decisions.semantics: getMovePriority adds field priority (Chess king, Grassy Glide, Dimensional Quash, Deep Earth Core Enforcer). The rollout orders actions with the simulator's own getActionSpeed priority for the candidate, including converted Z/Max moves.
tests: strategy decisions consume the measured field mechanic in every AI prediction category

field priority additions cover hard terrain, overlays, chess roles and negative moves

decisions.semantics: getHealAmount / getDrainAmount predict field healing and draining. The rollout heals and drains through the simulator, so the strategy sees the source amounts (Grassy Giga Drain 75%, Back Alley 0.67, petrification blocking). Where the AI's estimate differs from the source mechanic the strategy follows the mechanic: Battle_AI.rb:9158 and 9167 apply x1.3 to every drain on Forest and Icy/Snowy Mountain, but Battle_Effects.rb:1189-1192 (absorbHP) applies them only to Strength Sap and Matcha Gotcha.
tests: strategy decisions consume the measured field mechanic in every AI prediction category
Floral Healing fully restores recipients in Grassy terrain
Petrification blocks direct healing, recovery and draining moves

decisions.semantics: hpGainPerTurn predicts end-of-turn HP from field damage and healing. Each rollout runs the simulator's residual events with the field engine; the residual term values the actual change. The prediction-versus-mechanic audit checks the predicted fractions on every named field; where the AI's estimate differs from Rejuvenation's own residual code (Corrosive ability damage on the wrong field, sleep damage counted twice, Dry Skin heal amount, Chlorophyll exemption) or from the documented Holy Salt Cure divisor decision, the strategy follows the shipped mechanic. 9259 subtracts Wildfire damage unconditionally in the source AI, whereas Battle.rb:7146 applies it only with the Wildfire ability; the rollout applies the real condition.
tests: AI end-of-turn HP predictions agree with the shipped residual mechanics
strategy decisions consume the measured field mechanic in every AI prediction category

decisions.semantics: pbStatChangingSwitch(Opponent), quarkdriveCheck, pbFormChangeUponSwitchIn, pbAegislashStats and totalHazardDamage predict what happens when a Pokemon enters: field stat changes, Healing Wish/Lunar Dance boosts, paradox activation, forms and field-modified hazard damage. Switch, pivot, phazing and faint-replacement rollouts use the simulator's switchIn/runSwitch with the field engine, so these entry effects are measured; hazard values are measured the same way. The audit checks every predicted stage change; Quark Drive/Protosynthesis on New World/Desert and Mirror Armor on Colosseum are AI expectations that Rejuvenation's own entry code does not implement (Battler.rb:3417-3442, :2365 misspells MIRORARMOR), and the strategy follows the source.
tests: AI switch-in stage predictions agree with the shipped entry mechanics

decisions.semantics: getMoveScore raises or lowers the expected stage changes of a move on a field (statarray/selfstatboost/oppstatdrop). The rollout uses the move, the field engine applies the real stage changes, and the next-turn matchup (accuracy-, critical- and speed-aware damage potential of both sides) values them. The prediction audit verifies every named move/field/stage; Scary Face on Haunted (AI -4, source -3: Battle_MoveEffects.rb:1646) is priced at the source value and Struggle Bug's mention in the 0x44 handler is unreachable because its Swamp effect lives in 0x45.
tests: AI stat-change predictions agree with the shipped field mechanics
setup and recovery have measured future and residual consequences

decisions.semantics: Companion statements of audited stage predictions: the opponent-boost half of Flatter/Swagger on Colosseum (2280, 2286; audited with 2278/2284) and No Retreat's defensive drops on Chess/Big Top (3559; audited together with 3556). Valued by the same rollout and matchup.
tests: AI stat-change predictions agree with the shipped field mechanics

decisions.semantics: Moves that change the field (sown seeds, Icy/Haunted destruction to the backup field, Water Surface/Misty pollution, Mud Sport shorting Electric Terrain, terrain moves that become the field on Indoor) are valued in the source by getFieldDisruptScore(current)/getFieldDisruptScore(new) (Battle_AI.rb:1908 and these branches). getFieldDisruptScore is generated from the source (scripts/generate_ai_disruption.py) and equals the original Ruby method on 10,000 oracle matchups; the rollout performs the real transition and the strategy applies the source sqrt(current/new) scaling to the move's value. Overlay terrains keep the team field-affinity valuation, as the source returns a neutral field score for them.
tests: generated getFieldDisruptScore and switch-in affinity ports equal the original Ruby methods
a move that changes the field is valued by the source disruption rule (Battle_AI.rb:1908) in both directions
Mud Sport shorts Electric Terrain for five turns and restores it on expiry

decisions.semantics: getMoveScore multipliers for moves whose effect a field changes: boosted or weakened power, charge turns skipped or failing (Fly/Dig/Dive/Bounce/Phantom Force/Solar Beam/Razor Wind/Sky Attack/Meteor Beam/Electro Shot/Geomancy), recharge removed, eruptions and cave collapses, field-strengthened trapping, Aqua Ring/Ingrain/Wish/Floral Healing/Life Dew amounts, petrification, status spread, hazard conversion or failure (Wasteland, Water Surface, Electric/Crystal/Corrupted/fire/doubled rocks), weather moves on fields, and transitions rated neutral by getFieldDisruptScore (Flower Garden stages). Each named move has a rule in that field's definition (or acts through a generic field system such as residual damage); the rollout executes it and the strategy values the result through damage/HP, residual, lasting status/hazard/screen/slot-condition terms, the next-turn matchup, deferred strikes of charging moves, recharge cost and field valuation. The AI's numeric weights are replaced by these measurements. 2941 applies Swamp Ingrain damage although the source does it only outside Rejuvenation (Battle.rb:6351); the rollout follows the source.

decisions.semantics: Bounded source strategic preferences for Ashen Beach storms/Twister/Whirlpool, Glitch Ice Fang, Dragons Den water moves and party preservation, Volcanic Top rampages, Rainbow/Mountain snow and Rocky flinch. Source weights alter option value; an immediate winning KO is retained rather than following the source zero multiplier. The explicit weight has source-line provenance and a sign/KO decision fixture.
tests: source move preferences influence strategic value without suppressing immediate KOs

decisions.semantics: Weather hiding the stars is valued for both living parties. Reserve matchups are measured after real entry in the candidate context and the captured original decision context. A source-informed type-party term accounts for concealing Dark/Fairy/Psychic benefits; opposing reserves are included, improving the source own-party-only test.

decisions.semantics: Bounded opponent utility/protection/switch policy is measured through actual actions, queued in the simulator with all doubles actives. One plausible alternative is combined with the damaging reply, with accuracy/secondary weighting in both branches. This observes field status shields, speed control, spread protection, setup/Taunt and locked-attack switches. Sucker Punch and Upper Hand use actual queued choices; Upper Hand consumes effective field priority in the shared runtime, matching source Battle_MoveEffects.rb:9925.

decisions.semantics: The simulator actual remaining weather/terrain/room duration scales signed measured next-turn and reserve-context utility. Longer favourable effects gain value; longer unfavourable effects cost value. Original snapshots and real entry effects provide the baseline; no extension formula is duplicated.

decisions.semantics: Hazard option value gains the source 1.3 phazing synergy only when a simulator action actually sets forceSwitchFlag, respecting field and ability prevention. Real switch rollouts price imminent Deux Finalis seed/perish death, loss/restoration of entry effects, field-created Chess king priority immunity and Corrosive entry costs. The source fixed anti-switch weights are replaced by actual consequences and future matchup value.

decisions.semantics: Helper scores used by getMoveScore whose field branches describe real field mechanics: passive speed gains (Motor Drive/Steam Engine), perfect accuracy (Fairy Aura), Ice Face on Frozen Dimension, phazing failing on Colosseum and entry drops on dimensional fields, Flower Shield/Rototiller/Aromatic Mist boosts, Slow Start on Deep Earth, weather and terrain moves failing on fields, Competitive on Chess, Aurora Veil without hail, Glitch Hyper Beam and special stats, grounding, Serene Grace on Rainbow, Download on Dimensional, Lucky Chant/Amulet Coin, Back Alley Snatch and healing, field Wish/Salt Cure/Nightmare/Curse/Destiny Bond, Focus Punch on Electric Terrain, Telekinesis on Psychic Terrain, Iron Ball/Float Stone on Deep Earth, Recycle on Starlight, Raging Fury on Volcanic, Chess castling, hazard removal and one-hit KO immunity or perfect accuracy (Chess pawns, Colosseum Stalwart, Fairy Aura on Fairy Tale). The rollout executes the moves and abilities with the field engine and the outcome is valued by the same terms as other consequences (hazard removal through measured hazard impact).

decisions.semantics: The getSwitchInScoresParty field table (433 weights for abilities and types per field) is generated from the source (scripts/generate_ai_affinity.py) and equals the original Ruby table on 6,000 oracle cases; the source's misspelled PERSIHBODY is deliberately read as Perish Body. It drives switch screening, pivot and faint replacements and team field valuation (temporary fields, overlays and expiry). The source applies it for best-skill trainers; the strategy models the best-skill AI.
tests: generated getFieldDisruptScore and switch-in affinity ports equal the original Ruby methods
lookahead screening keeps ordinary, Z, Dynamax and native candidates and reports screened variants explicitly

decisions.semantics: Switch-in scoring beyond the field table: seeds changing types/abilities on entry (Inverse, Swamp, Underwater, Glitch), Lunar Dance roles, moves usable on fields, Perish Body on Holy, survival abilities (Stalwart), contact punishment, Starlight priority, Cell Battery, Chess king entry, Corrosive Mist Aftermath and priority blocking. Every switch candidate that is rolled out (the native switch is always rolled out, plus the best screened reserves) enters through the simulator and plays the turn, so these consequences are measured for it.
